ref-31.heading: If you like what you see at an open home
ref-31.text: We recommend you hire a property inspector to check the structure of the house. You can have them check a property before you make an offer or as a condition of your offer. They can provide feedback about the roof, insulation, doors, windows and more.
ref-31.quote: They can provide feedback about the roof, insulation, doors, windows and more.

ref-39.heading: Summary of important things to know
ref-39.text: A land information memorandum (LIM) provides a summary of property information held by the different departments at the local council.

ref-39.heading: Summary of important things to know
ref-39.text: The property file at the council may contain a lot of relevant information that isn’t on the LIM such as a site plan and the original plans of the house.
ref-39.quote: a site plan and the original plans of the house.

ref-39.heading: Title search
ref-39.text: The legal owner of the property (proprietor).

ref-39.heading: Title search
ref-39.text: You may find other less common interests on a title.

ref-39.heading: Council Information
ref-39.text: There should be consents filed in the property file or the LIM for any work completed if consent was required for that work.
